license_parking.title: License Parking — Unused License Detection
license_parking.plain_language: License parking means paying for licenses that are assigned to users who are not using them. This includes disabled accounts, long-inactive users, and unassigned licenses.
common_issues: Disabled accounts still assigned expensive licenses
Users inactive for 90+ days still consuming license seats
Licenses purchased but never assigned to anyone
recommended_actions: Immediately reclaim licenses from disabled accounts
Review users inactive 90+ days and reclaim if no longer needed
Set up quarterly license audit process
Use dynamic groups to auto-assign licenses based on role
